title: Aya Vision Public Launch
summary: Cohere Labs announced Aya Vision on March 4, 2025 as a multilingual multimodal model supporting text-and-image tasks across 23 languages.
significance: A dated public-launch milestone in the Aya research program, extending the program into multilingual multimodal text-and-image capabilities.

verification.note: Cohere Labs' first-party launch post is dated March 4, 2025 and announces Aya Vision as an open-weights multilingual multimodal model. Cohere's first-party model documentation independently corroborates the Aya Vision 32B model, text-and-image modality, 23-language scope, and open-weight availability. The later primary technical report, submitted May 13, 2025, documents Aya Vision 8B and 32B and is retained as chronology context rather than evidence for the March launch date. This candidate records the dated public-launch milestone only and does not infer development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, or relationship edges.
